about_the_game:
Dopaminer is a relaxing idle/clicker focused on chasing dopamine. Click the floating dopamine bits to earn DP, invest that DP in strategic upgrades, automate your dopamining and use Rewire to increase efficiency with each run.

Increase your Effective Score to unlock higher tiers where new mechanics become available. Encounter rare dopamine bits that provide larger payouts. Automation features allow steady progression whether you are actively clicking or letting it play for you while you’re away.

Key Features

Click. Upgrade. Automate. Rewire. Easy to learn, hard to stop.

Four Upgrade Tabs:

* Core: Enhances bit value, spawn rate, lifetime, and chain lengths

* Automation: Start Auto-Collecting, enable Magnet Bursts to gather bits, and Overclock those upgrades!

* Rarity: Increase how often valuable dopamine bits will pop up and increase multipliers

* Meta: Prestige system with Synapse Points that unlock permanent perks and strategic advantages

 Tier Progression: Achieve key score milestones to unlock new automation and expanded upgrade options.

Prestige: Use Rewire to reset progress while retaining Synapse Points, boosting future runs through permanent meta-upgrades.

Offline Progress: Step away and return to a nice chunk of extra DP.

Steam Achievements: Dopaminer has got you covered. Unlock achievements naturally as you reach new milestones and optimize your runs.

Dopaminer is your next satisfying click!

And the click after.

And that one too. Maybe automate it. Oh dear, here we go again!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) or Intel 64-bit (Core i3+)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (Intel HD 4000/Iris or better, AMD Radeon HD 7000+, Apple M1 GPU)
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Internet only required for Steam features (Cloud/Achievements/Overlay). Offline play supported.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i5+
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU with 1 GB+ VRAM (Apple M1/M2 GPU, Intel Iris Plus, or discrete AMD)
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Runs natively on Apple Silicon. 64-bit only.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent (64-bit)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11–capable GPU (Intel HD 4000 / NVIDIA GTX 600 / AMD HD 7000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit OS required. Internet only needed for Steam features (Cloud/Achievements/Overlay). Offline play supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3 (64-bit)
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11–capable GPU with 1 GB+ VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD RX 460 / Intel Iris Plus or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Windowed or fullscreen. Runs on laptops and desktops; no special peripherals required.

short_description: A cozy idle/clicker about tuning your machine: tap to collect, stack upgrades, unlock new tiers, automate progress, and Rewire to prestige. Spend Synapse Points for permanent perks and watch each run accelerate, even while you’re away.
